title: ASE A6 Certification Practice Test
content:
ASE A6 Electrical Electronics Practice Test
61. The shifter on the automatic transmission above will not shift out of PARK unless the shift interlock solenoid is commanded ON with a scan tool. Technician A says a faulty shift interlock solenoid has caused this condition. Technician B says a faulty brake switch could be the cause. Who is correct?
- A. Technician A
- B. Technician B
- C. Both A and B
- D. Neither A or B
62. The electrical symbol above is :
- A. A resister.
- B. A capacitor.
- C. An inductor.
- D. A diode.
63. An alternator suffers from low voltage output. The alternator outputs maximum voltage when full-fielded. Which of the following is MOST likely at fault?
- A. A burned diode.
- B. A worn alternator brush.
- C. A faulty regulator.
- D. A faulty rectifier bridge.
64. Technician A says a fully charged lead-acid automotive battery has a specific gravity of 1.265 at 80° F. Technician B says the battery's specific gravity is affected by temperature. Who is correct?
- A. Technician A
- B. Technician B
- C. Both A and B
- D. Neither A or B
65. There are no brake lights when the brake pedal is depressed. Technician A says this is most likely caused by a bad brake light bulb. Technician B says this is most likely caused by a blown stoplight fuse. Which technician is correct?
- A. Technician A
- B. Technician B
- C. Both A and B
- D. Neither A or B
